title: Zoom Contra #8
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 5 "ones contra corners" can't start from where the dancers are: contra-corners: the 1s need a couple above and below.
Row 1 "down the hall and turn as a couple" can't start from where the dancers are: hall starts before a waiting couple finishes crossing.
Row 5 "ones contra corners" can't start from where the dancers are: contra-corners: the 1s are not a couple standing in a place.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
